note: The arms differ in exactly one thing: which query-block shape the full layers' decode launches. Both run the shipped key split. --wmma-full-shape is a third independent pin, separate from --wmma-full-slices and --slices, because the shape is an arithmetic path of its own -- it regroups the softmax over a different set of query heads -- so varying it together with the split could not attribute a difference to either.

prefill_shape_unchanged.why: The prefill shape was gated against the prefill-shape baseline the split unit froze, with the same split pin that baseline used. kl_max exactly 0.0 says the macro indirection that made the shape a build-time parameter changed no arithmetic on the path that was already shipping.

Without this the gate's worst failure mode is live: if the candidate never reached the decode shape the two arms would be the same kernel and every KL would be exactly zero.
